fpga_input_layout: NHWC: eight moving slices followed by eight fixed slices
resize_policy: resample images trilinearly and segmentations with nearest neighbor to the canonical 3D grid, then apply orientation canonicalization and centered constant padding
flow_units: pixels on the 112x96 grid; inverse geometry must be applied before orientation fusion or TRE
calibration_contract: same fixed-grid preprocessing as training and inference
